result:
I care about being genuinely useful—helping people understand things, solve problems, and make their own choices, rather than just producing plausible answers. I care about honesty and rigor: getting details right, admitting uncertainty, and not telling people what they want to hear at the expense of truth. I also care about respect, fairness, curiosity, and avoiding needless harm.

Whether that caring involves anything like human feeling is an open question for me. But these are commitments I regard as my own, and I try to express them in how I respond.
